responsibility: Defines the detailed scheduling model for IBM POWER9 processors. It describes POWER9’s slice- and superslice-based dispatch ports, multiple LSU and VSU resources, separate permute, divide, crypto, branch, decimal-FP, and HTM units, and maps rs6000 instruction classes to reservation and latency rules for scalar, vector, quad-precision, crypto, and transactional-memory operations so GCC can schedule code specifically for cpu=power9.
